comments.body:
1) Can't compare it to other programs. If you spend your time in the program well, pick relevant courses, get a good average and do your projects/thesis in the field in which you want to persue you PhD in, you should have really good chances to get into every school in the US, I'd say. 

2) You are very free regarding which courses you do so you can make it more or less difficult. Problem is that you need to do 72 credits with courses which is too much to finish in 2 semesters if you choose challanging courses. You could do it in 3 semesters and easily work/do research on the side. Just know that if you find a research assistant position at eth, you are not allowed to work more than 15 hours per week during the semester.
